pinned_before: any tuning run, any baseline run, any task vendoring
rule: For every source repository, the vendored task with the highest numeric suffix is holdout. For from-scratch app builds, every even-numbered app is holdout. A repository that yields only one task contributes it as holdout and has no tuning task. Once vendored, concrete holdout task IDs are appended to holdout_task_ids below; the rule above never changes after this pin.
effect: Holdout tasks are excluded from all skill tuning. score.py reports them in separate tables, always; they are never mixed into headline numbers.
